lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most kinds of changes (adoption new_flow, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, finish copy, finish hint, finish redesign, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (3 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with two tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

candidates.title: Choose Path Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen layout into a interactive visual carousel showcasing pet styles.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating user indecision during path selection.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the path selection screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 23.8%, but redesign of choose_path showed no clear effect across 2 prior tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Account Notice
candidates.change: Display explicit guidance on the sign-in screen reminding users to log into their existing account to retain pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account resets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Use your original email account to restore all your existing pets and progress.

candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated preview screen after uploading photo assets to show how the custom pet renders on desktop backgrounds.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 66.2% conversion rate and support logged 3 issues regarding custom pet creation failures or poor rendering.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_preview']

candidates.why: Users wait a median 201s on home and support received 3 emails reporting pets failing to display on the desktop.

waiting.body: Preparing desktop graphics and verifying window overlay compatibility...

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and long wait times, but home wait_info changes have shown no clear winning effect across 3 tests.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, finish copy, finish hint, finish redesign, sign_in hint, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with three tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign changes (2 tests), results disagree with one winning test and one showing no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.
